# RL stack, installed in its own Dockerfile layer, pinned exactly.
# torch/torchvision are installed separately in the Dockerfile from the
# CUDA-matched wheel index (cu124) when GPU=on, or the default CPU index
# when GPU=off -- pins live here as the single source of truth for both.
# The whole file is also passed to pip as a constraints file, so nothing
# else can pull in a different torch.
#
# numpy 1.24.x, not 1.26: apt's python3-scipy 1.8 (pulled in by ROS) warns
# on every import with numpy >= 1.25.
numpy==1.24.4
torch==2.5.1
torchvision==0.20.1
gymnasium==0.29.1
stable-baselines3==2.4.0
tensorboard==2.18.0
# Not a feature dependency, a guard: keeps pip from installing a setuptools
# that shadows apt's 59.6. setuptools >= 80 breaks colcon's ament_python
# builds (canonicalize_version() TypeError) and colcon-core requires < 80.
setuptools<80
